summary: Iteration 98 — Deployed AI-employee @mention auto-responder + Builder Program rejection cooldown & audit trail. Backend 5/5 pytest passing (test_iteration98_deploy_cooldown_audit.py): (1) deploying an AI employee with channel=handle + handle=helpbot<hash> and mentioning @<handle> in a chat produces an ai_answer message from sender_id=ai-emp-<eid> within ~15s with metadata.deployed_employee_id=<eid>; (2) plain non-@mention messages do NOT trigger a bogus AI reply — regression confirmed; (3) SCOPING — a channel=chat deployment bound to chatA does NOT respond when @-mentioned in chatB; (4) REJECTION COOLDOWN — apply→reject→re-apply returns 429 with 'You can re-apply after <YYYY-MM-DD>', GET /api/builder-program/me returns can_reapply=false + reapply_at + reapply_cooldown_days=30, audit trail returns one row with decision='rejected', decided_by=amit@demo.team, note='not yet', created_at; non-super calling audit → 403; (5) multi-decision audit — approve after fresh apply appends an 'approved' row with the note. WEB UI (Chromium, 1440x900, buildertest@example.com/Demo@2026): /builder-program renders data-testid='bp-declined' with body 'Application not approved · ui test · You can re-apply after 8/10/2026.' and bp-form is NOT present — cooldown card verified. MOBILE UI (Expo web preview, 390x844): CONFIRMED BUG — mb-bp-declined does NOT render after a rejection; mb-bp-form is shown instead. Root cause verified: race condition in /app/mobile/app/builder-program.tsx — the screen calls apiGet('/api/builder-program/me') in useEffect BEFORE the AuthProvider has loaded tn_token from localStorage/SecureStore into the module-level _token in /app/mobile/src/api.ts, so the request goes out unauthenticated, backend returns 401, .catch fallback sets me={builder_access:false} (no application field), and the component falls through to the mb-bp-form branch. A direct fetch to the same endpoint with the token attached returns 200 with the exact expected {can_reapply:false, reapply_at, application:{status:'rejected'}}, confirming the backend is correct and only the mobile UI is affected. ESCALATION-in-chat coverage: not explicitly verified via pytest (base auto-response + metadata verified; escalation-rule branch left uncovered because we couldn't spin up a save+trigger flow within budget). @cmo/@sales pre-built AI employee regression: not re-verified this iteration (out of budget); iteration_93+ confirms.

rca of the issue: Mobile mb-bp-declined missing after rejection — RCA: /app/mobile/app/builder-program.tsx line 24 calls `apiGet('/api/builder-program/me')` in useEffect at mount. /app/mobile/src/api.ts line 6 stores `_token` at module scope. The AuthProvider (/app/mobile/src/auth.tsx) hydrates `tn_token` from localStorage asynchronously in its own useEffect and only then calls `api.setToken(t)`. On cold navigation (page reload, deep link) the screen's useEffect wins the race → apiGet goes out with no Authorization header → backend returns 401 → the screen's .catch sets `me = {builder_access: false}` (no `.application` field) → the `declined = app && app.status === 'rejected' && me.can_reapply === false` branch is false → falls through to the `mb-bp-form` branch. Reproduction: log into mobile as buildertest, navigate to /builder-program after any state where the user has been rejected — mb-bp-form is shown. Mitigation: (i) gate the screen on `useAuth().token` (only call `load()` when token is present), or (ii) have api.ts hydrate the token synchronously from localStorage on first request when on web.
